Job Description As our Order to Cash Accountant, you will join our OTC team in Sri Lanka where we strongly believe that working hard and having fun are two compatible elements. Job Description Summary We are seeking an experienced Senior Data Engineer with strong expertise in CRM data integration, analytics solutions to implement data pipelines for ingesting HubSpot data into the IFS Enterprise Data Lake and model the analytical solution for report & AI consumption. This role requires strong experience in HubSpot data structures, data modeling, data integration and analytics platforms. The Data Engineer will collaborate closely with Data Lead, stakeholders, marketing and sales teams, data engineers, analytics teams and enterprise architect to deliver secure, scalable and high-quality data solutions that support reporting, dashboarding and advanced analytics initiatives. The Senior Data Engineer will be responsible for the implementation of scalable, integrated data solutions across the L2O landscape. Working closely with Systems Integrators (SI), IFS, Data & Analytics teams, PMO and Sales stakeholders, the role ensures optimal data integration pipelines, high data quality and ensure minimal impact on the data model. The engagement will look at the existing data models built from THOR/ IFS Cloud & provide a least minimal impact solution with data sourced from Hubspot. The successful candidate will work under the direction and guidance of the Senior Director, Data & Analytics, who will provide strategic oversight, business priorities and ensure successful project delivery. The role will also work closely with the Senior Technical Manager, Data & Analytics on solution architecture, technical design, implementation planning, data integration activities and adherence to enterprise data standards. Key L2O Scope Covered by the Role Implement HubSpot data pipelines into the Data Lake Implement secure data extraction processes from HubSpot using APIs, connectors or integration services. Development and deployment of automated data ingestion pipelines to load HubSpot data into the IFS Enterprise Data Lake. Implementation of data transformation, cleansing and standardization processes in accordance with approved business rules and data models. Design incremental data integration patterns to support timely analytics and operational reporting. Develop metadata, lineage and documentation standards for HubSpot data assets within the data lake ecosystem. Collaborate with business stakeholders, analytics teams and data engineers to ensure minimal reporting impact during the transition from the existing CRM platform (THOR/ IFS Cloud) to HubSpot. Optimize data pipelines and storage structures for performance, scalability and cost efficiency. Create Data Models for Analytics & AI Create data models to support reporting, analytics with minimal downstream impact. Be involved in stakeholder workshops and requirement gathering sessions to capture business, functional and reporting needs. Document data pipelines, schema and transformations Document analytical use cases, KPIs, metrics, dashboards and reporting requirements. Define data quality, validation, reconciliation and exception-handling requirements. Capture security, privacy, compliance and data governance requirements. Document user roles, access controls and data consumption requirements for business and technical stakeholders. Develop process flows, data flow diagrams and functional specifications to support implementation. Facilitate requirement reviews, stakeholder sign-off, and change management throughout the project lifecycle. Provide traceability between business requirements, functional requirements and solution design artifacts. Qualifications Overall Required Competence Essential Experience 5-8 years of experience in data engineering. 3+ years of hands-on experience with Microsoft Fabric and Azure data platforms. Microsoft Fabric AI Capabilities Azure AI Services Azure Machine Learning Proven experience designing enterprise-scale data models and analytics platforms. Strong data management skills Good understanding of Star Schema based framework, Data warehouse and Data Mart and Materialized View Good understanding of database concepts like normalization, joins, changing dimensions etc.. Good understanding of relational and non-relational database management systems Experience in  CRM, CPQ, sales, commercial, ERP or quote-to-cash / Engineer-to-order solutions. Job Description The role of IFS Lead Cloud Performance Engineer exists within the Unified Support organization/division. As part of a shift operation, they will contribute towards providing 24x7x365 support to IFS customers across the globe within the Aerospace & Defense (A&D) industry vertical. This position sits within the Unified Support Performance Team dedicated to our Ultra High Availability (Ultra HA) on Oracle Exadata customers. The team owns proactive performance monitoring, deep-dive diagnostics, tuning and capacity management across the full stack Oracle Database on Exadata, the IFS application tiers, and the supporting cloud and network infrastructure to keep these mission-critical environments fast, stable and continuously available. As Lead Cloud Performance Engineer, you will be responsible for handling performance-related technical issues reported by customers, service requests, and problem and change management. You will lead performance investigations end to end from detection in the monitoring and observability platforms, through root cause analysis on the Oracle Database and application tiers, to the permanent fix or tuning recommendation. This role involves collaborating with various internal and external stakeholders to ensure problem-solution fits, which ultimately leads toward customer success. You will also play a crucial role in development and maintenance of IFS's products and internal systems. Work with other Service Center functions and appropriate stakeholders to resolve long running, complex or major incidents. Create and update relevant SOPs, FAQs and other documentation to address known issues, workarounds, and service requests. Manage an incoming queue of cases, incidents, and service requests within SLA, OLA and KPI targets. Support the event management team and their work to enhance the related event processes and tools. Proactively monitor the performance and availability of Ultra HA on Exadata environments, and detect, triage and resolve degradation before it impacts the customer's Moment of Service. Perform deep-dive Oracle Database performance troubleshooting wait event and AWR/ASH analysis, SQL and execution plan tuning, RAC and Data Guard behavior, storage and I/O bottlenecks on Exadata. Analyze end-to-end application performance across the IFS application tiers using APM and observability tooling, correlating application traces with database and infrastructure telemetry. Build and maintain dashboards, alerts and SLO/SLI reporting in Elasticsearch, Grafana and Open Telemetry-based tooling, and continuously reduce alert noise and false positives. Lead performance root cause analysis for major incidents and produce tuning, configuration and capacity recommendations for customers and internal stakeholders. Contribute to capacity planning, load and stress testing, and pre-upgrade or pre-release performance validation for Ultra HA customers. Boost productivity significantly with AI by reducing redundant, admin‑heavy tasks and enabling teams to focus on higher‑value work. Liaise with IFS R&D and Unified Support Engineering organizations for automation requirements to support cloud-based applications. Liaise with IFS R&D and Unified Support Engineering organizations for knowledge sharing with Unified Support Service Operations groups in relation to cloud-based applications. Identifying knowledge gaps and compile/ update internal Knowledge Based Articles (KBA) to guide Unified Support Service Operations groups in relation to supporting cloud-based applications. Identify and communicate improvement points related to Standard Operating Procedures (SOP) and Processes to the relevant process owners. Qualifications A university degree or an equivalent professional qualification in Software Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology or similar. Experience in a modern ticket/service desk tooling such as ServiceNow, Jira Service Desk, or a similar tool. Experience in ITIL, ISO 20000, or a similar IT service delivery framework. Mandatory Skills At least 7+ years’ experience in cloud computing services, enterprise IT delivery services or similar, including demonstrable experience troubleshooting performance in production Oracle Database and enterprise application environments. Understanding the low-level concepts in Cloud computing. Oracle Database performance monitoring and troubleshooting, together with application performance monitoring, are essential for this role. The successful candidate will additionally have at least half of the remaining skills below, or a suitable professional grade qualification. Cloud service administration and operations (Azure, AWS & GCP). Demonstrate proficiency in debugging complex applications. Linux Server administration. Network administration. Oracle Database administration, with strong monitoring, performance diagnostics and troubleshooting skills (AWR/ASH/Statspack, SQL and execution plan tuning, wait event analysis, Oracle Enterprise Manager). Working knowledge of Oracle Exadata and high-availability architectures (RAC, Data Guard, ASM), including their performance characteristics. Application performance monitoring and observability instrumenting, analyzing and tuning application-tier performance. Hands-on experience with Elasticsearch, Grafana, Open Telemetry or comparable APM/observability tooling (for example Dynatrace, AppDynamics, New Relic, Prometheus). Web Server administration (Wildfly, WebLogic & Nginx). Kubernetes/Docker operations and administration. BASH/PowerShell/Terraform/Ansible scripting usage. Soft Skills Ability to work to deadlines and targets. Ability to manage own time efficiently and effectively. Ability to work in international, multi-disciplined, cross-functional teams. Flexibility to work to deadlines and needs of the role. Ability to read and understand technical documentation written in English. Ability to mentor and provide a good role model for junior team members. Problem-solving skills and the ability to change approach based on information gathered during the process. Good communication and interpersonal skills. Strong organizational skills and ability to multi-task. A positive team player with a can-do attitude. Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English. Ability to self-learn and quickly understand new and changing technologies in a fast-moving service driven technology landscape. Proactivity and ownership of work items in all aspects of the technical and team role. Additional Information We embrace flexibility and hybrid work opportunities to support diverse needs and lifestyles, while also valuing inclusive workplace experiences. By fostering a sense of community, we drive innovation, strengthen connections, and nurture belonging. Our commitment ensures you can work in a way that suits you best, while also engaging with colleagues to share ideas and build meaningful relationships.

Job Description This role will act as a strategic partner to Product, Engineering and Platform leadership teams, while also supporting team-level improvement conversations where the insights are most useful. The role helps teams improve execution health, delivery effectiveness, product quality, and organizational performance through data-driven insights, AI-enabled analysis, and evidence-based decision making. The successful candidate will combine strong business acumen, engineering knowledge, analytical capability, and executive influence. They will work closely with senior leaders to identify opportunities, diagnose systemic challenges, and drive measurable improvements across product organizations. This is not a reporting-only or dashboard-building role. This is a business partnering role where data serves as the starting point for strategic conversations and operational improvement. You can be located in any of these countries; UK, Sweden or Sri Lanka Key Responsibilities Strategic Partnering Act as trusted partner to Product Group leadership teams. Participate in leadership team meetings and operational reviews. Develop deep understanding of business objectives, challenges and priorities. Provide independent, evidence-based perspectives to leadership teams. Partner with Community of Practice leaders to provide insights into organization-wide trends, opportunities, and areas requiring attention. Help Communities of Practice identify emerging themes and prioritize improvement initiatives using objective data and evidence. Intelligence & Insights Develop and maintain a data-driven framework for measuring and understanding software engineering execution health, delivery performance, quality, and organizational effectiveness. Identify emerging risks, trends and opportunities. Produce actionable insights rather than reports. Use AI-enabled analysis to accelerate pattern detection, summarization, anomaly identification, and insight generation while ensuring outputs are explainable, validated, and grounded in trusted data. Root Cause Analysis Analyze the underlying causes of changes in delivery flow, quality, developer productivity, and team health indicators. Combine quantitative data with qualitative context. Distinguish symptoms from systemic causes. Facilitate fact-based decision making. Driving Improvement Help leadership teams prioritize areas of focus. Define measurable improvement initiatives. Establish success measures and outcome indicators. Track effectiveness of actions over time. Shape Intelligence Products Provide structured feedback into the Product Intelligence platform or insights app so that recurring user needs, data gaps, and adoption blockers are captured and addressed. Help translate leadership and team-level insight needs into reusable intelligence products, dashboards, narratives, and self-service capabilities. Partner with the Product Intelligence platform team to continuously improve the insight experience, data quality, and practical usefulness of the platform. Organizational Learning Surface recurring patterns, risks, and opportunities across product groups and engineering functions. Work closely with Community of Practice leaders to identify systemic challenges and opportunities for improvement. Provide data-driven insights that help Communities of Practice focus their efforts on the areas with the greatest potential impact. Contribute to improvement initiatives through evidence-based recommendations. Leverage AI Use AI responsibly to accelerate insight discovery, reduce manual analysis effort, and make complex engineering and product signals easier to interpret. Identify opportunities to apply AI to trend analysis, natural-language insight summaries, anomaly detection, knowledge discovery, and proactive recommendations. Ensure AI-generated insights are validated, explainable, and used as decision support rather than as a substitute for engineering judgment and leadership context. What Success Looks Like Product, Engineering and Platform leadership teams use insights regularly to prioritize improvement opportunities and make better-informed operating decisions. Teams move from static reporting to evidence-based conversations that lead to clear actions, owners, and measurable outcomes. Recurring execution, quality, delivery flow, and developer experience issues are identified earlier and addressed through focused improvement initiatives. Community of Practice leaders receive useful organizational signals that help them prioritize practices, reusable assets, and improvement themes. The Product Intelligence platform or insights app improves over time through a strong feedback loop from real leadership and team-level use cases. AI-enabled capabilities reduce manual analysis effort and increase the speed, reach, and consistency of insight delivery. Qualifications At least 7–10 years of experience in software engineering, product development, engineering operations, product operations, consulting, analytics, or related leadership roles. Experience working directly with senior leadership teams and influencing decision-making through data-driven insights. Strong understanding of modern software engineering practices, software delivery lifecycles, and organizational effectiveness. Deep understanding of software delivery effectiveness frameworks and metrics, including DORA, SPACE, flow metrics, developer experience, and the appropriate use of metrics as signals rather than targets. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Proven ability to translate complex datasets into clear executive-level insights and actionable recommendations. Job Description IFS Academy is on the lookout for a dynamic and open-minded individual to join us as a Functional Trainer and Consultant Business Applications in the Service Management and / or Asset Management functional areas. You will be responsible for designing and delivering functional training courses at IFS. As a member of the IFS Academy functional training team, you will be working closely with colleagues from all over the world, sharing your knowledge, while further developing your skills as a Consultant Business Applications and a Functional Trainer. Working with cutting-edge industry solutions together with colleagues in the IFS Academy Functional Training team and consultants across the organization. Designing, developing and delivering functional training courses to functional consultants of the IFS Community (IFS Internals, Partners, and Customer). Conduct training using a variety of instructional techniques and delivery methods, including classroom-based learning and virtual learning. Contribute to self-paced, microlearning training as a subject matter expert in the Service Management and / or Asset Management business domain process & functionality. Evaluating and improving training courses and content. Maintaining a very good understanding of the continuously evolving IFS products, industry solutions and its functionality. Previous experience as a trainer or lecturer will be an advantage. Excellent command of English and good communication skills. Ability to understand, summarize and present information in a clear and concise manner. Service-minded and organized with the ability to multitask and prioritize effectively. Join Team Purple. Join IFS. Job Description We're rebuilding how IFS ships software around autonomous, AI-native teams, and we're looking for someone to lead one. You'll write production code following agentic engineering principles, own it in production, and set the bar for a small team of engineers who do the same. The software you'll build runs the real world. It's the workforce management & planning, project delivery and scheduling systems that construction and engineering companies use to run major programs. The people using it are planners, schedulers, project managers and site teams whose decisions carry real cost and real risk. When your code is right, their projects land. That's the feedback loop, and it's a good one. What makes this different We treat AI-assisted development as a core capability, not a novelty. Claude Code and Cursor are part of the daily workflow here, not something on a "tools we're evaluating" slide. We build agentic and LLM-backed features into the product, using RAG, agentic architectures, evaluation harnesses and context engineering, where they solve a real customer problem rather than chase a trend. If you've already changed how much you can ship and how fast because of the way you work with these tools, you'll be in good company. We work in a forward-deployed way. You'll get into real customer environments, and shape the technical decisions, rather than working from a requirements document written by someone who's never been on site. Your goal will be to use these oppurtunities to bring customers the most value. And you'll own the whole thing: design, build, test, deploy and run. Modern general-purpose languages, full stack, on a cloud-native platform with Kubernetes, CI/CD, IaC/GitOps and observability. Quality and security are built in as you go, not bolted on by a downstream gate. What you'll do Lead a small, autonomous team by setting technical direction, driving delivery and quality, and growing the engineers around you. Design and ship full-lifecycle features across front-end and back-end. Build and consume the APIs and event-driven services that connect workforce, project, scheduling and financial data across IFS Cloud and customer systems. Make performance and scalability decisions that hold under load. Get into customer environments, test your assumptions against reality, and bring that evidence back into the build. Document the why, not just the what, and help raise the practice of everyone you work alongside. Qualifications What we're looking for A strong engineer who genuinely enjoys leading people and wants to stay close to the code while doing it. You take ownership without being asked, make progress when the brief is half-formed, and would rather ship and iterate than wait for perfect. You have depth in at least one area, whether that's front-end, back-end, data, quality, security, platform or applied AI, and the range to work across the stack. You've led or mentored engineers, and people tend to get better for having worked with you. You reason from the customer and commercial outcome as much as the technical one. And you're genuinely fluent with AI tools and agentic patterns in real engineering work, not just familiar with them. Nice to have A degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related field, or the equivalent proof in what you've built. Experience shipping AI-backed features such as LLM integration, RAG or agentic patterns. Experience with enterprise, ERP or project-based software, or exposure to construction, engineering or other field-heavy industries. Experience of agile delivery with globally distributed teams and leading them. Job Description Asset-intensive industry is entering an AI-enabled, data-driven, increasingly autonomous era — and nowhere is the value more concentrated than in shutdowns, turnarounds, outages, maintenance campaigns, and major capital builds, where scope, readiness, cost, and safety decide success. This role sits at the centre of that shift. As a Product Manager for Enterprise Asset Management, you'll own products that maximise asset value, reliability, and uptime while reducing risk and total cost of ownership across the full asset lifecycle — from capital build through operation, maintenance, and turnaround. You bring deep insight into project-based work — shutdowns and turnarounds (STO), campaigns of work, and major capital projects — and you champion high AI agency, treating agentic AI as a core capability, not a feature. You'll serve asset-intensive operators across IFS's key industries-  Energy, Utilities & Resources, Manufacturing, Construction & Engineering, Communication, Aerospace & Defence, and Service Industries. Core Responsibilities Strategy & Vision — Set a clear product vision and roadmap tied to measurable outcomes: asset availability, reliability, maintenance cost, and turnaround schedule and budget adherence. Build strong investment cases and drive growth across core and AI revenue streams, aligned with the Asset Lifecycle Management portfolio. Customer Discovery — Lead discovery with maintenance, reliability, operations, turnaround/STO, and capital-planning leaders. Go deep on scope challenge and optimisation, readiness, resource mobilisation, scheduling, and cost/risk control. Prioritise ruthlessly on measurable value. High AI Agency & Agentic Innovation — Embed agentic AI into project-based work: autonomously assembling and challenging turnaround scope, optimising campaign and outage schedules, surfacing readiness gaps, and continuously replanning as conditions change. Operate with high personal agency in your own use of AI to prototype and validate fast. End-to-End Ownership — Own the lifecycle from concept to launch to scale. Remove blockers and drive to outcomes — including the hard schedule and cost deadlines that govern turnarounds and capital projects. Keep Engineering, Design, Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success aligned. Commercial Impact & GTM — Define differentiation and value for asset-intensive buyers and event leaders. Support pricing, packaging, launches, and customer presentations. Own adoption as a core metric. Job Description Purpose The Senior Information Security Engineer is a senior technical and leadership role within IFS’s global Security Operations Center (SOC), responsible for driving advanced threat detection, deep-dive investigation and major cyber incident response across a fast-growing, global SaaS business. This role combines hands-on operational excellence with a mandate to mature the SOC itself – leading capability-building and transformation initiatives that scale detection engineering, automation and analyst tooling in step with IFS’s growth. The Senior Information Security Engineer acts as the senior escalation point for high-priority incidents, mentors and uplifts Tier 1/2 analysts, and brings a genuinely curious, investigative mindset to uncovering and closing gaps in the organization’s defensive posture. Summary IFS is seeking an experienced and highly curious Senior Information Security Engineer to strengthen its global Security Operations Center. Reporting to the SOC Manager, this role is central to detecting, investigating and responding to advanced threats across a fast-scaling, global SaaS estate, while also leading the ongoing transformation and maturity uplift of the SOC function itself. We are looking for someone who has thrived in a fast-growth organization and is comfortable building process and capability from a lower level of maturity, and confident designing the detection engineering, automation and reporting foundations that a scaling security function needs. You will be very familiar with responding to cyber incidents and will experience leading major cyber incident responses, bringing the calm, structured leadership that high-pressure investigations demand. This position suits a technically strong, and curious security professional who enjoys digging beneath the alert to understand root cause, who takes ownership of SOC transformation initiatives, and who can mentor and elevate the analysts around them. Key Responsibilities: Major Incident Response & Leadership: Lead and coordinate the end-to-end response to high-priority and major cyber incidents – acting as senior technical authority and calm decision-maker under pressure, from triage through containment, eradication and post-incident review. Deep-Dive Investigation & Threat Validation: Perform advanced forensic analysis, malware and log investigation, and root-cause assessment, applying a naturally curious, hypothesis-driven approach to uncover threats others might miss. SOC Capability Development & Transformation: Design, lead and deliver SOC maturity and transformation initiatives – from detection engineering and use-case development to workflow automation, tooling consolidation and process redesign – drawing on proven experience building SOC capability within a fast-growth organization. Threat Detection Engineering: Build, tune and continuously improve SIEM detection logic, alerting and correlation rules (preferably Microsoft Sentinel) to reduce false positives and improve signal quality. Proactive Threat Hunting: Conduct intelligence-led threat hunts using MITRE ATT&CK and emerging TTPs, identifying gaps in detection coverage before they can be exploited. Automation & AI Enablement: Champion the use of automation, SOAR playbooks and AI-assisted tooling to increase SOC efficiency and free analysts for higher-value investigative work. Vulnerability & Risk Management: Support vulnerability scanning, risk-based prioritization and remediation tracking across the environment. Runbooks, Documentation & Quality: Own the creation and continuous improvement of incident and detection runbooks, ensuring documentation quality and consistency across the SOC. Team Development & Mentorship: Act as an escalation point and mentor for Tier 1/2 analysts, coaching investigative technique, structured incident handling and a culture of curiosity. Governance, Metrics & Reporting: Contribute to SOC KPI reporting and ISMS audit readiness, and support the continuous improvement of SOC policies and standards, translating technical findings into clear reporting for stakeholders. Tooling & Vendor Input: Maintain deep proficiency across SOC tooling (SIEM, EDR, SOAR, cloud security) and contribute to tooling strategy, renewals and annual security budget planning as the SOC scales. Qualifications Essential: 5+ years of experience within a Security Operations Center (SOC) or Cyber Defense function, including demonstrable experience operating within a fast-growth or rapidly scaling organization. Proven track record of developing SOC capability and delivering SOC transformation or maturity programs (e.g. detection engineering, automation, process redesign, tooling consolidation). Hands-on experience leading major or high-priority cyber incident response, from initial triage through to executive-level post-incident reporting. Strong hands-on expertise with SIEM (preferably Microsoft Sentinel), EDR (e.g. Microsoft Defender for Endpoint) and SOAR platforms. Advanced analytical and investigative mindset, with a genuine, demonstrable curiosity for understanding root cause and emerging threat techniques. Strong forensics and security analysis skills, with the ability to make sound, well-informed decisions with minimal supervision under pressure. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to brief non-technical and executive stakeholders during live incidents. Degree in Cyber Security, Information Technology, Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent demonstrable experience. Desirable: Experience with SOC automation, AI-enhanced detection and response, KQL analysis, scripting or Python. Exposure to threat intelligence platforms and structured frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK. Familiarity with cloud security (Azure/AWS) and modern cyber defense methodologies. Experience mentoring or leading junior analysts within a SOC environment. Relevant certifications such as CISSP, CISM, GCIH, GCIA, CEH, Azure SC-200/AZ-500 or equivalent blue-team certifications. Why Join Us Opportunity to shape and lead the transformation of a growing global SOC function, with a clear path toward Lead Security Engineer and SOC leadership roles. Exposure to enterprise-grade security platforms and global cyber defense operations across a fast-growth SaaS business. A collaborative, high-performance culture where curiosity, ownership and continuous improvement are genuinely valued. Competitive salary, certification sponsorship and career development.
